data.name: Solitaire.KlondikeHint
data.value: Click a card, then its destination. Click the selected card again to cancel. Double-click a top card for foundation. Stock draws one.

data.name: Solitaire.FreeCellHint
data.value: Build down in alternating colors. Empty cells hold one card. Click the selected card again to cancel. Double-click sends a card home.

data.name: Solitaire.SpiderHint
data.value: Build down freely; only same-suit runs move together. The selected run gets a gold outline. Complete King-to-Ace runs. Stock deals ten.

data.name: Solitaire.PyramidHint
data.value: Select two exposed cards totaling 13. The selected card gets a gold outline. Kings clear alone. Draw when no pair is available.

data.name: Solitaire.GolfHint
data.value: Click a top card one rank above or below the waste. Aces and Kings do not wrap.

data.name: Solitaire.TriPeaksHint
data.value: Clear exposed cards one rank above or below the waste. Aces and Kings do not wrap.
